data.name: Earth
data.description: Kineticists who focus on the element of earth are called geokineticists. Geokineticists manipulate the earth itself, and they are masters of defensive techniques.

raw_tokens.value: Kineticists who focus on the element of earth are called geokineticists. Geokineticists manipulate the earth itself, and they are masters of defensive techniques.
&nl;Class Skills: A geokineticist adds Climb and Knowledge (dungeoneering) to her list of class skills.

&nl;Wild Talents: 1st-basic geokinesis, earth walk, kinetic cover, pushing infusion; 2nd-bowling infusion, earth climb, entangling infusion; 3rd-impale, jagged flesh, magnetic infusion, rare-metal infusion, tremorsense; 4th-enduring earth, shift earth; 5th-earth glide, stone sculptor, tremorsense (greater); 6th-deadly earth; 7th- fragmentation, shift earth (greater); 9th-seismic master.
